run_inference_benchmark_sweep: run an inference benchmark sweep across multiple GPU configurations using SLURM job scheduler
calculate_node_gpu_distribution: calculate the number of nodes and GPUs per node for a given total GPU count
load_hydra_config: load a Hydra config from a YAML file with optional overrides and merge with JobConfig
generate_scaling_plots: generate weak scaling and strong scaling plots from aggregated benchmark results
collect_benchmark_results: collect and aggregate benchmark results from completed SLURM jobs into a JSON file
